blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: dictionary coding — Encodes recurring sequences by referring to dictionary entries.
token — Short code representing a longer sequence.
overlap — Repeated sequence used by more than one part of the source.
lossless — Reconstruction is exact when dictionary and token mapping are known.
